releaseNotes: Added AI Data Library for reusable external evidence references and ICEops-managed copies used by the existing bounded local evidence pipeline.

AI Data Library shows managed storage usage, file count, external-reference count, and keeps automatic cleanup OFF by default. External source files are never deleted by ICEops; managed copies require an explicit confirmed Delete Copy action.

SQLite/DB, CSV/TSV, JSON/XML/text/log evidence selected from the library continues through the existing read-only AiAttachment/AiLocalEvidenceSummarizer path; no new AI write authority or Grounding relaxation was introduced.

Main-shell co-branding was simplified: the SMC footer logo was removed from the main UI and Pepperl+Fuchs branding was enlarged and emphasized. Device/vendor-specific assets elsewhere remain unchanged.

V971 deterministic AI source was compile-hardened, including the CS0165 connected definite-assignment fix in single-port evaluation; the Evidence -> Criteria -> AI Explanation policy and strict Grounding behavior are unchanged.

V970 Safe Disconnect, V969 updater authority, communication, Polling/MAX, PDO/ISDU, Output Coordinator, Studio Runtime, permissions, HMI read-only, Signal Tower control and 8-port runtime behavior are unchanged.

en: Added AI Data Library with reusable external references, optional managed copies, storage usage and explicit removal/deletion controls.
External originals are never deleted; only ICEops-managed copies can be physically deleted after confirmation, and automatic cleanup remains OFF.
Main footer branding now emphasizes Pepperl+Fuchs and removes the SMC co-brand logo from the main shell.
V971 deterministic AI/Grounding logic remains strict; only compile-hardening changes were applied to that evaluation source.
ko: 외부 파일 참조와 선택적 관리 복사본을 재사용할 수 있는 AI Data Library, 저장용량 표시, 제거/삭제 기능을 추가했습니다.
외부 원본 파일은 ICEops가 삭제하지 않으며 ICEops 관리 복사본만 확인 후 실제 삭제할 수 있습니다. 자동 삭제는 기본 OFF입니다.
메인 하단의 SMC 공동 브랜딩 로고를 제거하고 Pepperl+Fuchs 로고를 확대해 메인 제품 브랜딩을 강화했습니다.
V971 결정론적 AI/Grounding 정책은 그대로 유지하며 해당 평가 소스에는 빌드 안정화를 위한 컴파일 하드닝만 적용했습니다.
ja: 外部ファイル参照と任意の管理コピーを再利用できる AI Data Library、ストレージ使用量表示、削除管理を追加しました。
外部の原本は ICEops が削除せず、ICEops 管理コピーのみ確認後に実ファイルを削除できます。自動削除は既定で OFF です。
メインフッターの SMC 共同ブランドロゴを削除し、Pepperl+Fuchs ロゴを拡大して製品ブランディングを強化しました。
V971 の決定論的 AI / Grounding ポリシーは維持し、評価ソースにはビルド安定化のためのコンパイルハードニングのみ適用しました。
zh-CN: 新增 AI Data Library，可复用外部文件引用或可选的托管副本，并显示存储使用量及删除管理。
ICEops 永远不会删除外部原始文件；只有 ICEops 托管副本可在确认后从磁盘删除，自动清理默认关闭。
主界面页脚移除 SMC 联合品牌标识并放大 Pepperl+Fuchs 标识，以强化产品主品牌。
V971 的确定性 AI / Grounding 策略保持严格不变，仅对评估源代码进行了编译稳定性加固。
de: Die AI Data Library verwaltet wiederverwendbare externe Dateiverweise und optionale ICEops-Kopien inklusive Speicheranzeige und Löschsteuerung.
Externe Originaldateien werden von ICEops niemals gelöscht; nur verwaltete Kopien können nach Bestätigung physisch entfernt werden. Automatische Bereinigung bleibt standardmäßig AUS.
Im Haupt-Footer wurde das SMC-Co-Branding entfernt und das Pepperl+Fuchs-Branding vergrößert und hervorgehoben.
Die strikte deterministische AI-/Grounding-Policy aus V971 bleibt unverändert; am Evaluator wurden nur Compile-Hardening-Anpassungen vorgenommen.
es: Se añadió AI Data Library para referencias externas reutilizables y copias administradas opcionales, con uso de almacenamiento y controles de eliminación.
ICEops nunca elimina los archivos originales externos; solo las copias administradas pueden borrarse físicamente tras confirmación. La limpieza automática queda desactivada por defecto.
El pie principal elimina el co-branding de SMC y amplía la marca Pepperl+Fuchs para reforzar la identidad principal del producto.
La política determinista de AI/Grounding de V971 sigue siendo estricta; el evaluador solo recibió ajustes de compile-hardening.
